text: All uploaded data from 1-8 September compared with 1-8 October 2026
A visual manager pack for clear conversations and practical recovery plans.
Each slide contains a small number of creators for one manager. Read the cause first, then use the manager conversation as the action to agree.
The cause section shows whether the gap comes from live hours, streams, matches, or weaker conversion at similar activity.
Use the written action to agree a live schedule, match plan, or a visual and conversion review with the creator.
The goal is a practical change in the creator's next lives, rather than simply recording the issue.
